summary: Exported UnifiedRadixCache's previously internal L3 prefetch lifecycle counters as bounded-label Prometheus metrics, added full/partial/miss request and token classification, emitted request-correlated structured query and terminal prefetch logs, documented the diagnostics, and preserved monotonic counter behavior across repeated flushes and cache reset epochs.

tests.what_was_measured: 16 CPU unit tests, including failing-before coverage for metric export, delta-only repeated flushes, reset epochs, fixed-label rejection of unknown/user-controlled keys, and existing storage failure-token metrics. Raw JUnit: reports/j-733d68ee5ddd/cpu-observability.xml

One-GPU ROCm HiCache file-storage round trips over the supported parameter matrix: 13 passed, 6 repository-gated skips, 2553 deselected. The test exercises L3 query, host staging, GPU load-back, byte-for-byte K/V comparison with producer tensors, and verifies the new hit counters reach StorageMetricsCollector. Raw JUnit: reports/j-733d68ee5ddd/gpu-hicache-roundtrip.xml
Repository formatting, Ruff lint/format, import ordering, codespell, AST, conflict, secret, and registered-test policy checks.

tests.command: isolated prometheus_client generate_latest probe using StorageMetricsCollector
tests.what_was_measured: Real Prometheus exposition contained hicache_prefetch_outcomes_total, hicache_storage_requests_total, and hicache_storage_query_tokens_total with the expected bounded labels and 5 hit / 3 miss tokens for an 8-token partial-hit fixture.

remaining_limitations: No C++/FlyDSL/native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.

No model-weight HTTP serving run was needed for this metrics-collector and cache-runtime change; the deterministic tiny Llama fixture would validate transport/engine execution but not add coverage beyond the direct HiCache GPU round trip.
Mooncake, HF3FS, NIXL, UMBP, multi-node, TP/PP distributed, and unavailable model-specific storage paths were not exercised on this single-GPU node.

The new lifecycle snapshot originates in UnifiedRadixCache, the current comprehensive cache implementation. Legacy HiRadixCache continues to expose its existing success/bandwidth and unfulfilled-token telemetry but does not produce the new query-result snapshot.
The change exposes and classifies the issue's confirmed remaining gap; it does not duplicate existing L1/L2 byte, token, duration, eviction, or dropped-token metrics.
